business_summary: Loews Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides commercial property and casualty insurance in the United States and internationally. The company offers specialty insurance products, such as management and professional liability and other coverage products; surety and fidelity bonds; professional liability coverages and risk management services to various professional firms, including architects, real estate agents, and accounting and law firms; standard and excess property, marine and boiler, machinery coverages, workers' compensation, general and product liability, commercial auto, umbrella, excess and surplus coverages, specialized loss-sensitive insurance programs, total risk management services relating to claim and information services; directors and officers, errors and omissions, employment practices, fiduciary, fidelity, and cyber coverages, as well as for small and mid-size firms, public and privately held firms, and not-for-profit organizations; and insurance products to serve the health care industry, including professional and general liability, as well as associated casualty coverage to aging services, allied medical facilities, dentists, physicians, nurses, and other medical practitioners. It also provides warranty and alternative risk, and run-off long-term care insurance products; ethane supply and transportation services for petrochemical customers, as well as transports and stores natural gas and natural gas liquids; operates a chain of hotels; develops, manufactures, and markets a range of extrusion blow-molded and injection molded plastic containers; and manufactures commodities and differentiated plastic resins. The company markets its insurance products and services through a network of retail and wholesale brokers, independent agents, brokers, and managing general underwriters. Loews Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: Loews Corporation은 자회사를 통해 미국 및 국제적으로 상업용 재산 및 상해 보험을 제공합니다. 회사는 관리 및 전문가 책임, 기타 보장 상품과 같은 전문 보험 상품을 제공합니다. 보증 및 신실성 채권; 건축가, 부동산 중개인, 회계 및 법률 회사를 포함한 다양한 전문 회사에 대한 전문 책임 보장 및 위험 관리 서비스; 표준 및 초과 재산, 해양 및 보일러, 기계 보장, 근로자 보상, 일반 및 제조물 책임, 상업용 자동차, 우산, 초과 및 잉여 보장, 전문 손실에 민감한 보험 프로그램, 청구 및 정보 서비스와 관련된 전체 위험 관리 서비스; 이사 및 임원, 오류 및 누락, 고용 관행, 신탁, 충실성, 사이버 보장은 물론 중소기업, 공기업 및 비상장 기업, 비영리 조직을 위한 것입니다. 전문적 책임과 일반 책임은 물론 노령 서비스, 관련 의료 시설, 치과의사, 의사, 간호사 및 기타 의료 시설에 대한 관련 상해 보장을 포함하여 의료 산업에 서비스를 제공하는 보험 상품
